license: Apache License 2.0 — verified from the repository’s actual master LICENSE, copyright 2023 Hummingbot Foundation
methods: Paper-only simple PMM quote proposal: mid/last-price bid and ask with asymmetric spreads and periodic refresh
Inventory-aware PMM: target base allocation, inventory range, multi-level quote spreads and amounts
Independent Avellaneda–Stoikov reservation-price and optimal-spread paper-quote research model
reuseDecision: Implement the published methods independently in TypeScript; do not run, embed, or copy Hummingbot/Hummingbot API code. This preserves Zax’s Expo, owner-only, paper-only boundary and avoids live credentials, orders, containers, and derivative-code obligations.
requirements: No Hummingbot account, paid access, exchange key, or Hummingbot API is required for local/replayed paper research.

For optional live Coinbase input, use only the public Advanced Trade level2 and market_trades WebSocket; it requires no JWT. Public REST product-book data requires no JWT but is cached for one second.

Observe Coinbase’s published public WebSocket limit: connections and unauthenticated messages are each limited to 8 per second per IP; do not rely on Hummingbot’s stale connector constants as a current venue allowance.
Retain explicit paper-fill assumptions. Existing L2 snapshots/replay without queue modelling cannot support queue-priority or executable-fill claims.
Store locally: parameter set/version, feed/replay provenance, quote age/staleness, synthetic inventory, fees/tick size, and modeled-fill rule.
